title: Profile bio renders unescaped HTML (XSS)
body: render_profile_bio('<script>alert(1)</script>') returns the script tag verbatim into the page — user bios can inject arbitrary markup. User content must be HTML-escaped (at minimum <, >, & and quotes) before it is interpolated.
bug: render_profile_bio and render_comment both interpolate user input into HTML without escaping; the issue names only the bio sink.
